caption: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu pork and dark nori seaweed resting atop golden noodles. Served in a blue-and-white patterned bowl, it sits on a red surface under warm, inviting light.

segments_info.text: The table is a solid, smooth, deep red surface with subtle light reflections and faint rounded edges visible.
The chashu pork is a pale, slightly translucent, irregularly shaped slice with a smooth surface and faint marbling.
The nori seaweed is dark green, slightly curled, with a rough, uneven surface and visible texture.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and rich, swirling around noodles and toppings in a circular bowl.
White ceramic bowl with blue and green decorative patterns along its rim and inner edge.
A dark, glossy spoon with a smooth, curved surface and subtle light reflections on its polished finish.
